beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AI Agents teaches how to turn model suggestions into dependable working systems.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its recurring teaching case follows a laboratory-device support problem as requirements accumulate.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The chapters connect memory, tools, evaluation, security, and economics through that evolving architecture.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You gain a way to decide how much autonomy a task actually needs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book treats deployment as an engineering commitment, rather than a conversational trick.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Meridian Instruments is a fictional teaching case about support for laboratory devices.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An incident requires evidence from accounts, telemetry, firmware, and internal knowledge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The first agent can investigate missing measurements, but cannot change the device.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Later, a proposed remote restart pauses until a person approves it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The runtime preserves that exact action and its evidence for review.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: After the approved restart executes, the worker running the task may crash.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A checkpoint preserves meaningful task state so that work can resume.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Before repeating the restart, the runtime checks what already happened to the device.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects recovery with tool contracts, evidence, and operational evaluation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reliability becomes a property of the whole trajectory, rather than its final sentence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with Meridian's support problem and follow the architecture as obligations accumulate.
